name: mootrace
title: mootrace
blurb: type a handle and get a full grid of its mutuals: every pairing shows who broke the ice first, reading each mutual's entire post history (not a page-capped sample) for their earliest reply to the other. @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked how to build a grid of mutuals replying to every other mutual; @bisks.net tagged the bot to make it real.
